## About me

I'm a forest and fire ecologist with a heavy data science slant. 

As an applied Bayesian statistician, I’m deepening my machine learning expertise to better leverage remote sensing data. With a focus on monitoring forest and fire activity and improving fuel estimates, I’m honing the fundamentals of ML to apply them effectively in real-world, data-rich contexts.

## Open to opportunities

I'm open to collaborations, consulting, or roles using Bayesian methods, ML, and satellite data to advance understanding of forest and wildfire dynamics.
